exposure: Duration to achieve full enteral feeding
Small for gestational age at birth
cohort: 148 very low birth weight neonates admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit between January 2018 and June 2019
finding: The prevalence of extrauterine growth restriction (EUGR) at discharge was 68% in very low birth weight neonates, and EUGR was significantly associated with sepsis, longer hospital duration, and higher postmenstrual age at discharge.
